title: valeriana alternifolia f. angustifolia
intro: Valeriana alternifolia f. angustifolia, commonly known as a subspecies of the valerian plant, is a type of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. The health benefits of Valeriana alternifolia f. angustifolia include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality, making it a popular natural remedy for insomnia and restlessness. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of depression and restlessness. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates, which have been shown to interact with the GABA receptor, influencing the activity of the central nervous system.
